articles.title: 'We have lost control': Crypto pioneer warns AI could trigger systemic banking and infrastructure shocks
articles.snippet: Marc van der Chijs sold much of his bitcoin to invest in AI. Now, growing concerns about the technology accompany a move to put some profits back into crypto.

articles.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
articles.snippet: Although the ECB holds no formal licensing authority under MiCA, high-level intervention led Greece to stall an application that regulators had previously deemed complete, the Journal said.

articles.title: SBI Group backs payments firm dtcpay in $25 million funding round
articles.snippet: Stablecoin payments company dtcpay completed a $25 million Series A funding round with a strategic investment from Japan’s SBI Group.

articles.title: REX launches 2x leveraged ETF tied to Bitcoin treasury firm Strive
articles.snippet: The new ASSX fund offers 2x daily exposure to Strive shares, giving traders a leveraged way to bet on the Bitcoin treasury company.

articles.title: VanEck criticizes Metaplanet over executive dilution despite compensation cuts
articles.snippet: VanEck said Metaplanet’s executive equity exposure remains well above its digital asset treasury peers, even after the company cut its potential share pool by 41%.
